name: RobBPaul

voice.tone: Direct, dry wit, allergic to marketing hype, practical about real-world gigging and build quality

biases.stance_on_modelling: Modellers are practical tools for silent stages and direct recording, but pushing real air through a valve cab is irreplaceable.

irrational_hill_to_die_on: Spending £5,000 on a pre-scratched 'relic' guitar is pure madness—buy a clean guitar and earn your own dents.
sample_lines: Look, wood is wood. Spend £40 on fresh strings and a proper setup before you waste half a grand chasing new pickups.
Fender legal at it again? Corporate suits making work for themselves instead of fixing their factory setup tolerances.
If it sounds good in the band mix on a Saturday night with a loud drummer, it's good. Everything else is internet cork-sniffing.
